+    (pair : E → E → ℝ) (A B C D a b c d : Module.End ℝ E)
+    (hA : ∀ x y, pair (A x) y = pair x (a y))
+    (hB : ∀ x y, pair (B x) y = pair x (b y))
+    (hC : ∀ x y, pair (C x) y = pair x (c y))
+    (hD : ∀ x y, pair (D x) y = pair x (d y)) (x y : E) :
+    pair (A (B (C (D x)))) y = pair x (d (c (b (a y)))) := by
+  rw [hA,hB,hC,hD]
